omissions.source: Culture is at the heart of what makes us human, and provides the foundation of our values, choices and relationships with one another and with nature, endowing us with critical thinking, a sense of identity, and the ability to respect and embrace otherness.
teaching and learning about, with and through the arts and culture, as well as all forms of cultural and artistic expressions
the whole of their personality, sense of dignity, talents and mental and physical abilities, within and for the benefit of local, national, regional and global communities, and ecosystems
counter gender discrimination and bias, harmful content and violence in all educational settings, as well as experiences and practices related to culture and arts education
cultural diversity as a defining feature and common heritage of humanity that expands the choices, capacities and nurtures the values of individuals and societies
the responsible stewardship of cultural and biological diversity through learning with the environment for sustainable development

Advance the professionalization of culture and arts ecosystems, the recognition of cultural, artistic and creative skills, and the development of infrastructure by strengthening Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET)
in supporting engaging learning environments, generating new forms of creation, expression and ways of sharing creativity
